title: Students
subtitle: Register, enroll and manage students
noBranch: Select a branch from the switcher above to manage its students.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID code, phone…

wizard.pickBranch: Choose which branch this student is being registered at.
wizard.title: Register a student
wizard.subtitle: A guided registration — you can skip anything optional and complete it later.
wizard.photoHint: JPG or PNG, up to 4 MB. Optional.
wizard.createAccount: Create a login for this student
wizard.createAccountHint: They get an SMS link on their own phone to set a PIN.
wizard.documentsHint: Birth certificate, ID, transfer letter… uploaded when you finish.
wizard.guardiansHint: Add at least one parent or guardian. If they already use Temari.et at any school, find them instead of creating a duplicate.
wizard.searchParentPlaceholder: Search by ID code, phone or name
wizard.searchParentQuery: Type an ID code, phone or name…
wizard.searchParentHint: Works across all Temari.et schools — ask the parent for their ID code (e.g. H8R6WV).
wizard.enrollNowHint: Turn off to register the student without enrolling them yet.
wizard.enrollLater: The student will be registered without an enrollment.
wizard.previousSchoolHint: One directory covers Temari.et schools and others — add it if it's missing.
wizard.feesNeedGrade: Pick an academic year and grade to see the fees that apply.
wizard.noApplicableFees: No active fees apply to this grade yet.
wizard.scholarshipReasonRequired: Enter a reason for each scholarship.
wizard.uploadFailed: The student was saved but a file failed to upload — try submitting again.
wizard.checkErrors: Some fields need attention — check the steps for highlighted errors.
wizard.reviewHint: Check everything before saving — use the pencil on any section to fix it.
wizard.payAccountRequired: Select which bank account or wallet received each fee marked as paid.
wizard.guardianRequired: At least one parent or guardian is required.
wizard.hasPhoneHint: Only the student's personal number — parents' phones go on the Guardians step.
wizard.idLoginTitle: No phone? They sign in with their Student ID
wizard.idLoginBody: A Temari student ID is created automatically. Sign-in instructions and a PIN setup link are sent to the primary guardian by SMS — clearly marked as the student's login, separate from the guardian's own account.
wizard.createIdLoginHint: The primary guardian gets the setup SMS. Recommended from Grade 5 up.
wizard.idLoginAuto: Student ID login is created automatically
wizard.willCreateIdLogin: Will sign in with Student ID
wizard.registeredGuardianSms: Guardian accounts were created and each new guardian was texted a PIN setup link.
wizard.moreDetailsHint: Health information and documents — can also be added later from the profile.

bulkSection.title: Assign to section
bulkSection.mismatchHint: Students enrolled in a different grade or year are skipped automatically and reported.
bulkSection.unassigned: {count} students returned to the unassigned pool.

enroll.heading: Enrollment
enroll.title: Enroll student
enroll.optional: Enroll now (optional) — you can also enroll later.
enroll.noYears: No academic years yet. Create one first.
enroll.yearNotActive: This is not the active academic year — its status is “{status}”. New students normally enroll in the current cycle; double-check before continuing.
enroll.yearConfirmBody: “{year}” is not the active academic year — its status is “{status}”. New students normally enroll in the current cycle. Are you sure you want to use this year?
enroll.noSections: No sections yet. Create one first.

existingParent.found: {name} already has a Temari.et account with this phone number.

editEnrollment.title: Edit enrollment
editEnrollment.sectionCleared: The grade changed — pick a section for the new grade, or leave empty to assign later.

empty: No students yet. Register the first one.

detail.noGuardians: No guardians yet. Add the first one.

performance.emptyHint: Semester results appear here once they are computed.

detail.addLoginTitle: Create a login for this student
detail.addLoginHint: The student gets their own Temari.et account and receives an SMS link to set their PIN.
detail.loginPhoneNote: Must be the student's own number — a guardian's number cannot be used, parents already see their children from their own account.
detail.loginCreated: Login created — a setup link was sent by SMS.
detail.signsInWithId: Signs in with their Student ID + PIN
detail.loginModeIdNote: No phone needed. The student signs in with their Temari student ID and a PIN. The setup SMS — with the ID and a PIN link — goes to the primary guardian.

archive.badgeHint: Read-only archive — this student now attends another school
archive.title: Read-only archive
archive.body: This student transferred to another school. You are viewing the file exactly as it was on the day of transfer — documents, health data, guardians and address — alongside your school's own enrollment, results and fee records. Nothing added by the new school appears here, and nothing can be edited.

documents.empty: No documents yet — attach a birth certificate, ID or transfer letter.

guardians.name: Full name
guardians.added: Guardian added. They have been notified by SMS.
guardians.lastCannotRemove: A student must have at least one guardian — this is the last one.
guardians.phoneHint: The guardian's own number — their Temari account is created with it.
guardians.primaryPhoneHint: Primary contact — the account login SMS and the student's sign-in instructions go to this number.

parents.title: Parents
parents.subtitle: Every parent and guardian linked to your students
parents.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID code, phone, email…
parents.empty: No parents yet — they appear as guardians are linked to students.

bulk.inviteDesc: Each guardian gets a text with a link to set their PIN. Guardians with no login yet, or who already signed in, are skipped.

enrollment.pendingHint: Seat reserved — registration fee not settled yet
enrollment.activateDesc: {name} joins the class lists (attendance, continuous assessment) immediately. The unpaid registration invoice stays open and keeps its reminders.

claims.title: Login account claims
claims.hint: These people signed up with a phone number not on the school record and entered a student ID. Approve only if you can confirm they are the student.
claims.noPhoneOnFile: No phone on the student record.

import.title: Import students
import.subtitle: Bring a whole register in from Excel — upload, check, then import.

target.heading: Where do these students go?
target.fromColumn: From a column in the file
target.hint: Pick a default grade when the whole file is one class; otherwise map the file's grade column in the next step.

import.formats: .xlsx, .xls or .csv — parsed on your device, nothing uploads yet
import.emptyFile: That file has no readable rows.
import.parseFailed: Could not read that file — is it a valid Excel or CSV file?

map.heading: Match your columns
map.hint: We matched what we could — check each column and fix the rest. Unmatched columns are ignored.

grades.heading: Grades we could not recognize
grades.hint: Tell us once which grade each of these means — it applies to every row.

problems.name: Map a Full name column, or both First name and Father name.
problems.grade: Map a Grade column, or pick a default grade in the previous step.

row.title: Row {number}
row.savedWithIssues: Saved, but the row still has problems — see the highlighted fields.

resolutions.skipHint: Nothing is created — the existing record stays as it is.
resolutions.enroll_existingHint: No new person; the matched student is enrolled into this year.
resolutions.createHint: A genuine namesake — a brand-new student is created.

issues.grade_required: A grade is required — set one on the row or pick an import default.
issues.grade_not_offered: This branch does not offer this grade.
issues.section_unknown: This section does not belong to the import branch.
issues.section_grade_mismatch: The section belongs to a different grade.
issues.duplicate_in_school: A student with the same identity already exists at this school.
issues.exists_other_school: A matching student exists at another Temari school — a transfer may be the right move.
issues.already_enrolled: The matched student already has a live enrollment this year.
issues.guardian_existing: This phone already has an account — the existing parent will be linked, never duplicated.
issues.account_failed: The login account could not be created; provision it from the student profile.

commit.heading: Start the import
commit.accountsHint: Students with a phone get a phone login; the rest get an ID + PIN login.
commit.smsOffHint: Off — no SMS or email goes out. You can invite families later, once the data is verified.
commit.smsOnHint: On — new guardians receive account setup SMS messages. SMS costs money.
commit.errorsLeftBehind: {count} rows still need fixing and will not be imported.
commit.confirmBody: {count} students will be registered and enrolled. This runs in the background — you will be notified when it finishes.
commit.confirmSmsOff: No SMS will be sent to families.
commit.confirmSmsOn: SMS messages will be sent to the guardians of up to {count} students.

report.jobFailed: The import stopped unexpectedly. Rows already imported are safe — re-open and start again to continue.

bulk.activateDesc: Each student joins their class list. In hard-gate branches anyone whose registration fee is unpaid is skipped and named.
bulk.noPendingEnrollments: None of the selected students have an enrolment waiting to be activated.
bulk.inviteDesc: Each student gets a text with a link to set their PIN. Students with no login yet, or who already signed in, are skipped.
bulk.deleteDesc: They leave the register. History is kept and you can restore them.
bulk.restoreDesc: They come back on the register exactly as they were.
